idea-plugin.name: France E-Invoice Reception Lint
idea-plugin.description:
12 checks for the French mandatory mentions a PDP rejects, on Factur-X, UBL and CII invoices

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → France E-Invoice Reception Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 12 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/france-einvoice-reception-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/france-einvoice-reception-lint

action.text: France E-Invoice Reception Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run France E-Invoice Reception Lint on the file in the editor
